approaches.name: AI satellite and electronic monitoring for fisheries surveillance
approaches.description: The project uses AI-integrated satellite monitoring, electronic monitoring and automated information systems to collect bycatch data and modernize fisheries control. Practices: AI-integrated satellite monitoring for fisheries bycatch data; Electronic monitoring and IT-based MCS system modernization for fisheries control; automated fisheries information management system modules; real-time electronic monitoring of domestic longliner trips.
approaches.why_innovative: New service: AI-enhanced satellite monitoring pilot for bycatch data | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 2 round(s); context expanded; final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: State satellite monitoring program through technological upgrades (i.e., potential offices supported a pilot program for collection of data including artificial intelligence [AI] integration). bycatch data.

extra_evidence.text: FSM’s economic value from fisheries was increased with improved Development of an implementation plan for the FSM National Oceanic internal processes and systems and more effective control of fishing Fisheries Investment Policy and a review to leverage VDS days through rights through modernization of the MCS system and transparent management actions, increasing economic value of the scheme. information technology [IT] and electronic monitoring systems.

VDS supported with a reinforced observer program through VDS strengthened with the development of an information undertaking a functional, operational, and structural review of the management system, including Observer Placement and Observer observer program and expanding the staffing complement, and Recruitment modules and the enhancement of the electronic supporting observer training and awareness programs.

(2) Strengthened capacity for sector performance; and (3) Strengthened capacity for improved habitat preservation: (1) An operational fisheries monitoring and information management system facilitates dissemination of updated timely data to national and regional stakeholders (yes/no): (i) New automated information management system (IMS)6 modules providing timely access to fisheries data (number);

(ii) Domestic longliner trips monitored in real time via an upgraded electronic monitoring7 system Page 7 The World Bank Pacific Islands Regional Oceanscape Program – Second Phase for Economic Resilience: Federated States of Micronesia: (P178237) (percentage); and (iii) States’ coastal fisheries data management systems regularly updated with recent data (number).
